svg.title: The kit. Languages: Python (research and ML code), C++ (kernels and their hosts), C (systems), CUDA (SGEMM, warp divergence), SQL (the RISC-V database). Infrastructure: Nsight Systems (timelines), Nsight Compute (kernel profiles), Docker (containers), Linux (development), Git (version control), PostgreSQL (1,351 instructions, 8 tables), FastAPI (services). Machine learning: PyTorch (training), PyTorch Geometric (NodeGuard, dopant GNNs), scikit-learn (baselines), XGBoost (gradient boosting), LangGraph (multi-agent retrieval), FAISS (vector search). Speaks: Punjabi (native), Hindi (fluent), English (fluent).
